question: Identify the primary sector of the economy from the following options.
solution:
The correct option is **Agriculture**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **primary supplier** of raw materials for important industries is **agriculture**.
 
• **India's** terrain is generally quite **fertile**.
 
• **Food production** is becoming more and more **necessary** as a result of the **large population**.
 
• Any **industry** that extracts and produces **raw resources**, such as **farming**, logging, hunting, **fishing**, and mining, is considered to be a part of the primary sector of the** economy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **industrial sector** is referred to as a **secondary** sector.
 
• Since it provides **goods** and **services** to other companies rather than to **customers directly**.
 
• The **tertiary sector**—also known as the **service sector**—includes businesses including transportation, **banking, tourism**, hospitality, insurance, and trade.
 
• **Banking** is a part of the Indian economy's **tertiary sector**.
 
• Companies in the **primary sector** are directly involved in activities like mining and agriculture that use **natural resources**.
 
• Manufacturing and other **secondary sector** businesses **generate** things that are **derived** from **primary sector **products.
 
• The main **goal** of all human beings is to always be present.
 
• This goal relates to the **caliber** of the **action**.
 
• Anything one chooses to undertake is considered a **secondary purpose**. It has to do with the **content.**
